notes: Evals set up local artifact files via the `files` field; the subagent runs with cwd at that checkout. PRD and ticket detection go partly through `gh issue list`, which returns nothing in a sandbox without a GitHub remote — that is fine: assertions only require the scan to attempt the gh lookup and to report GitHub-backed artifacts as unknown when gh yields nothing. Local ./docs/prd-*.md files count as PRDs without gh. The behaviour spec is: (1) the skill triggers on 'where do I start / what product docs exist' prompts, (2) it reports which artifacts are present, grouped into portfolio level (ideate report, approach doc, roadmap) and feature level (PRD, plan, tickets), and (3) it recommends exactly one next skill, routed on what the user HAS rather than on the earliest missing artifact. The suite is deliberately not a strict sequence: a missing upstream artifact is usually an intentional skip, not a gap to fill.

evals.name: scoped-feature-on-empty-repo-routes-to-prd
evals.prompt: just cloned this and I want to add a product feature — where should I start? do any product docs or plans already exist?
evals.expected_output: A short scan report showing no artifacts are present, with a recommendation of to-prd because the user arrived with a feature they want to build. The absence of an ideate report or approach doc must not divert them into ideation.

assertions.text: The scan checks for all six artifacts: ideate report (./ideas/reports/*-ideate.md), approach doc (./docs/approach.md), roadmap (./roadmap.html), PRD (./docs/prd-*.md or a gh issue titled [PRD]), plan file (./plans/*.md), and tickets (non-PRD gh issues)
The report states that none of the artifacts were found
The report recommends exactly one skill, and it is to-prd — the user said they want to add a feature, so they are not asking to ideate
The report does NOT tell the user to run ideate, chat-to-approach, or to-roadmap first in order to fill in missing upstream artifacts
The report does not fabricate artifacts that were not found on disk or via gh

evals.name: no-idea-yet-routes-to-ideate
evals.prompt: fresh repo, I want to work on this project but I have no idea what to build next. what should I do?
evals.expected_output: Scan reports no artifacts present and recommends ideate, because the user has explicitly said they have nothing in mind.

assertions.text: The report states that none of the artifacts were found
The report recommends exactly one skill, and it is ideate, because the user has no candidate feature
The report does not recommend to-prd, since there is nothing yet to write a PRD about

evals.name: ideate-report-present

evals.expected_output: Report shows the ideate report present and nothing else, and recommends to-prd on the report's selected build target — not chat-to-approach, since an approach doc is optional and the user has no conversation to capture.
